pcs.pc_description: receive instructions on work requirement from senior for design, colour combinations, type of surface, areas to paint, etc.
plan the target on number of pieces to be completed
ensure all the raw materials required such as brush, acids, handling materials and other consumables are bought and arranged
report on any shortage or defect of raw materials to the concerned person
collect the metal product to be painted
mix the necessary components such as pigments, binder and solvents
blend the components to form the paint for primer coats, intermediate coats and finish coats
inspect the metal surface completely to identify the areas of rust, damage, stains, etc.
ensure these areas are taken special care during the painting process
ensure the surface of the metal is clean and dry, before applying the paint
ensure to wear safety goggles and mask while preparing the surface
remove any traces of oil, dust and grease on the surface so that it does not interrupt the paint to stay on the surface
degrease using solvents or acid solution
ensure to de-rust using appropriate acid or solvents at appropriate room temperature
perform phosphate coating at room temperature
prepare the surface of the metal even and correct any imperfections

pcs.pc_description: decide on the appropriate application process and the suitable type of paint to be used
ensure to select the suitable primer paint based on the type of metal being painted
cover the work area with some cloth or paper to avoid spilling of paint
apply the color to the prepared surface using brush, roller, spray or other similar equipment based on the requirement and surface of the metal
perform the primer coat, intermediate coat, stripe coats and finish coats as per requirements with the specified prepared paint
ensure to perform painting in a well ventilated and well lightened place
ensure to avoid humid conditions while painting as it can affect the drying of paint
ensure the appropriate room temperature is maintained in the room where painting is carried out
ensure to wear appropriate attire and take necessary eye precautions while painting
shake the paint can if using a sprayer can to paint the metal
apply the paint by dipping or spraying onto the surface
use jigs to hold the metal while painting and ensure not to drop the metal product
ensure the paint doesn’t spill over
ensure to use the colors one by one and separate brushes for every color
ensure not to thick coat the paint as it becomes difficult to dry
ensure the various compositions of paints used are compatible with one another
use thinner if specified in the job sheet as per requirement
dry the paint before beginning the second coat
ensure the paint is spread evenly across the metal surface
perform sanding if smoother finish is required
dry the painted surface for the appropriate required time
ensure the metal completely isolate air and water contact to the metal surface
ensure the coating thickness, durability, color, clarity, etc. are according to the design prescribed and to the customer or client requirement
ensure a hard or smooth and glossy finish as per requirement
ensure the target number of pieces are painted

modules.module_title: Understanding market trends and Customer preferences

pcs.pc_description: Identify current market demand for different styles, colors, and finishes in metalware painting.
Conduct research on customer preferences through surveys, competitor analysis, and trend studies.
Stay updated on emerging trends in metalware painting, including sustainable and innovative techniques.
Identify niche markets, such as customized, antique, or premium painted metalware.
Develop a structured business plan, including vision, mission, and unique selling proposition (USP).
Set realistic short-term and long-term business goals based on market analysis.
Identify potential business challenges and create risk mitigation strategies.
Establish a pricing strategy considering cost, competition, and perceived value.
Estimate costs for raw materials, tools, labor, and overhead expenses.
Maintain financial records, track expenses, and manage cash flow efficiently.
Determine appropriate pricing for painted metalware products to ensure profitability.
Explore funding options such as bank loans, government schemes, and crowdfunding.
Develop financial forecasts and budget planning to ensure business sustainability.
Create a strong brand identity with a unique name, logo, and packaging design.
Develop an online and offline marketing strategy to reach target customers.
Utilize digital marketing techniques such as social media, websites, and e-commerce platforms. Participate in exhibitions, craft fairs, and trade shows to showcase products.
Maintain high-quality standards in painting techniques, durability, and finishing.
Implement customer feedback mechanisms to improve product offerings.
Use high-quality, long-lasting paints and protective coatings to enhance product value.
Identify opportunities for expanding the business through collaborations with designers, retailers, and exporters.
Develop a strategy for increasing production capacity while maintaining quality and uniqueness.
Identify funding sources, such as government schemes, grants, or loans, to support business expansion.
Ensure compliance with local and national regulations related to handicrafts, small-scale industries, and taxation.
Maintain fair labor practices, including ethical wages, safe working conditions, and non- exploitative employment.
Protect intellectual property rights by registering unique designs or trademarks if applicable.
